name: Paracetamol (acetaminophen)
executiveSummary: First-line analgesic and antipyretic. Pediatrics: 10–15 mg/kg/dose PO; ≈ 60 mg/kg/day usual; do not exceed labeled daily ceilings because of hepatotoxicity risk.
indications:
## Indications

- Symptomatic treatment of **fever**.
- Mild to moderate pain.

## Precautions

- Risk of **hepatotoxicity** in overdose or excessive repeated dosing.
- Do not combine multiple paracetamol-containing products.
- Adjust in hepatic impairment; caution in malnutrition, alcoholism, and prolonged fasting.
- Minimum interval between doses: **4 hours**.

> Always dose by **current weight**. Confirm concentration (mg/mL) of drops/suspension before measuring volume.

adulto.presentation: Tablets 500–1000 mg; oral solution/drops by brand; IV ampoules 10 mg/mL.
adulto.dose: PO: 500–1000 mg every 6–8 h. **Usual maximum: 3 g/day** (some hospital regimens allow up to 4 g/day only under supervision without hepatic risk factors). IV: 1 g every 6 h (max 3–4 g/day per label), infused over 15 min.
adulto.administration: PO with or without food. IV as a short infusion per label.
adulto.notes: Add all paracetamol sources (cold combinations, opioid combinations). In hepatic impairment reduce dose/interval with specialist advice.

pediatrico.presentation: Oral drops/solution 100 mg/mL; suspension 32 mg/mL or other strengths; chewable tablets/suppositories by age.
pediatrico.dose: **15 mg/kg/dose PO every 6 h** or **10 mg/kg/dose every 4 h**. Recommended daily dose ≈ **60 mg/kg/day**. **Do not exceed 80 mg/kg/day** in children < 37 kg. If > 38 kg: adult-aligned maximum (**3 g/day**). Minimum interval: 4 h.
pediatrico.administration: PO with a calibrated oral syringe. Shake suspensions. Do not use household spoons.
pediatrico.notes: If no response 3–4 h after 15 mg/kg, dosing may advance to 10 mg/kg every 4 h without exceeding the daily maximum. Avoid routinely adding another antipyretic when already on 60 mg/kg/day, except for inefficacy with medical indication.

neonatal.presentation: Oral solution / IV per NICU protocol.
neonatal.dose: PO or IV: usual NICU regimens **10–15 mg/kg/dose every 6–8 h** (adjust for gestational/postnatal age and hepatic function). Do not exceed institutional maxima; watch for accumulation.
neonatal.administration: PO if tolerated; IV infusion per label.
neonatal.notes: Preterm infants may need longer intervals. Always confirm with the unit neonatology guide.

stability:
## Stability / storage

- Oral solutions: per label; keep tightly closed.
- IV: follow manufacturer dilution/stability; discard leftovers per local policy.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Usually well tolerated at therapeutic doses. Nausea, rash. In overdose: acute liver failure (treatable with N-acetylcysteine), nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, coagulopathy.
